visualCharacteristics: Full-width, edge-to-edge banner image spanning the content area; no overlaid headline, subheading, or CTA. Image renders at natural aspect ratio, full width.
contentPattern: A single image (picture) as the only cell. Image-only hero.
usage: Use for a standalone full-bleed banner/hero image at the top of a page where no overlaid text or call-to-action is needed.
